column4: Load repo context before exploring, and route new learnings to the right home.
Personal AI behavioral core. Interaction guidelines, surgical edits, simplicity bias, grounding/evidence requirements, infra safety, docs.
Bounded iterative work protocol for autonomous retries.
Do not use em dashes in any output
Write RFCs, Confluence pages, PRs, and messages in clear plain language for a broad technical audience.
Use Mermaid diagrams when they make flows, systems, or before-and-after changes easier to understand.
Cross-language reference - project workflow, languages, code standards, design principles, error handling, dependency patterns, tool aliases. Read when writing or reviewing code.

Generic debugging methods (domain-agnostic). Read when diagnosing a failure, an unexpected result, a flaky/silent CI job, or any situation where something should work but does not, in any repo or stack.

Post-PR cleanup workflow. Read this AFTER you help create a PR (gh pr create, git push of a new branch). It schedules a delayed check to verify the PR merged and prune local branches. Not needed otherwise.
